name: weather-display-visual
description: Visual verification of the weather system: weather cycle (sunny → cloudy → rain → heavy rain → storm → heat wave → cold snap), weather indicator icon in HUD, weather command output, and visual effects on terrain appearance.

steps.description: Left unmarked: bare `weather` is read-only (mining.ts's weatherCommand falls through to "return current weather" for any unrecognized subcommand) but isn't in interaction-executor.ts's OBSERVATION_COMMANDS -- adding the top-level token there would also silently permit `weather set`/`weather advance` for an observe-marked step, since isObservationCommand checks only the top token before the subcommand (the same class of mistake Finding #2's blast_plan note warns about). Fixing that needs a real mutate-vs-read-by-subcommand check, not a one-line list edit -- out of scope for a scenario conversion, left unmarked instead of force-fitting a role that doesn't quite hold.

Left unmarked: no UI sets weather at all -- grepping src/ui for gameConsole?.(`weather finds zero call sites. This is a real gap, not a conversion shortfall: nothing lets a player change the weather, only `weather set` from the console/scenario harness.
